title: HA WebSocket event of <ns>/family/subscribe
description: The event field of an HA event message of the subscription: the hub's push itself (family_relay.message), unchanged – e.g. family_request or family_child_updated for a family manager, kids_request_state for a child device – the same object the app gets on the hub WebSocket at home. Not wrapped. Also access_request_update, access_requests, access_request_state and access_request_error.
